BASE.note: original BSModel: local h0 + f + rho + 4-head attention readout (unchanged)

HIDDEN.note: BANK channels + hidden-space nonlinear task combination (capacity control, not a proposed model)

SREN-ADD.note: task-space scores already projected; sqrt(m) * mean aggregation

SREN-BANK.note: channel-wise evidence aggregation then task-linear projection

SREN-BANK-FLEX.note: BANK channels decomposed into mean / positive-gap / negative-gap with six task read heads

SREN-COMPOUND.note: per-root composite of incident relation tokens, then channel evidence + task-linear projection

SREN-EVID.note: task-space scores; sqrt(m) * (pi_mean*Mean + pi_pos*LME - pi_neg*LME(-)) aggregation

UNARY.note: real-pair token stream replaced by one SELF token per root (same relation MLP), BANK readout

LIPO.split: ogbg-mollipo official scaffold split (row ids of mol.csv.gz)

TOX21.split: frozen ChemBench Tox21 split (lcrc_predictive_trace_benchmark_v1 / molnet v2)

global_term.g: frozen label-free global descriptors (standardised) + Train-standardised log1p(n_atoms), log1p(n_relation_pairs)

param_matching.rule: closest active total parameter count to BANK; ties keep the smaller H; <=5% total or mark APPROX_CAPACITY_CONTROL

pcba_protocol.order_plan: ld.make_order_plan(official train rows, batch 128, seed 0, 40 epochs)
pcba_protocol.schedule: 1-epoch linear warmup 3e-5 -> 3e-4 then per-step cosine to 1e-5 over the 40-epoch horizon (never compressed)
pcba_protocol.selection: best Validation AP within the common horizon; extension resumes from checkpoint_last

pcba.loss: masked BCEWithLogitsLoss over observed entries only
pcba.scheduler: 1-epoch linear warmup then per-step cosine over the 40-epoch horizon
pcba.test_policy: official Test targets are NaN in the label artifact and are never indexed

test_policy.label: EXPOSED_TEST_ENGINEERING_COMPARISON_SET
test_policy.rule: one final scoring pass after every architecture/checkpoint/conditional decision is frozen; no architecture change afterwards; PCBA Test labels are NaN in the frozen artifact and cannot be scored

tokens.pair_set: all unordered root pairs with 1 <= shortest-path distance <= 2 (D=4 only for BEST_EXPLICIT_RANGE4)
tokens.relation_features: 5 distance one-hots (SELF,1,2,3,4) + log1p(common neighbours) + 13 raw bond features
